audit.scope: research-only; no builds, benchmarks, submissions, or production edits
audit.title: Ranked-best payload gap audit

comparison.caveat: raw candidate seconds came from different paired sessions and are not official speedups; the official paired score is authoritative

decision.reason: no ranked-best payload gap exists: current frontier equals e27 exactly, e27 directly inherits cc6 and only adds already-tested PR 549/604 mechanisms, and the exact combined payload scored 0.3766% below cc6 officially

frontier_equivalence.interpretation: the current frontier already contains the complete e27 submitted payload and therefore every cc6 executable mechanism

missing_or_excluded: cc6 prepared archive bytes/hash were not retained or published; exact content is reconstructed from its immutable receipt commit instead
CLI archive bytes are not safely reproducible from Git alone because packaging includes filesystem/tar metadata and deletes the temporary archive
cc6 paired component speedups were not available in the authorized receipt evidence
0.0011314403 prefill and 0.0134978831 decode values were explicitly labeled separate local measurements in the e27 note and are excluded from cc6 official timing
receipt direct URLs were unavailable; durable retrieval commands and receipt UUIDs are recorded
W&B links are contextual history only; neither receipt depended on a W&B payload artifact

the e27 validation commit object is not advertised by origin; its exact SHA, parent, and tree were independently inspected, while file records are reconstructed from the assignment base independently verified identical across all 142 submitted files

originating_changes.mechanism: retile fused decode embedding/RoPE atlas producer from 512 to 128 lanes and copy four 128-wide segments per lane
compute decodeAtlasPosition once and elide full/sliding attention mask construction only when no-mask safety is proven

positive_manifest_corruption_control.operation: flip bit 0 of byte 0 in memory; do not modify the worktree

e27f1ce4-23bb-4b5f-8e8e-90082be9ea3a.prepared_archive_hash_provenance: authoritative value observed in the receipt note; archive bytes were not retained and this hash was not independently reproduced
e27f1ce4-23bb-4b5f-8e8e-90082be9ea3a.role: stronger local M4 candidate / official challenger
e27f1ce4-23bb-4b5f-8e8e-90082be9ea3a.snapshot_reconstruction_provenance: assignment base was independently verified identical to all 142 e27 submitted files

canonical_logical_manifest.description: UTF-8 compact JSON array sorted by path; each object has path,size,sha256; JSON keys sorted; one LF appended
canonical_logical_manifest.reconstruction: common_files plus the selected receipt_specific_files record, sorted by path

submission_surface.path_provenance: current pinned benchmark.json defines the submitted paths; receipt validation commits preserve submitted files but omit benchmark.json
